description: This is a test class for the MainFragment UI component of the AnySoftKeyboard project, containing unit tests for UI behavior, menu commands, permissions, and backup/restore functionalities.

classes.name: MainFragmentTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the MainFragment UI component in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: testRootViewHasLatestLog
methods.description: Verifies that the root view contains the latest log with correct child views and visibility.

methods.name: testChangeLogDoesNotHaveLinkToOpenWebChangeLog
methods.description: Checks that the changelog does not have a web link to open.

methods.name: testTestersVisibilityInTestingBuild
methods.description: Tests visibility of UI elements when in a testing build configuration.

methods.name: testTestersVisibilityInReleaseBuild
methods.description: Tests visibility of UI elements when in a release build configuration.

methods.name: testShowsChangelog
methods.description: Verifies that the changelog is displayed correctly with a matching version title.

methods.name: testAboutMenuCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'About' menu command opens the correct fragment.

methods.name: testTweaksMenuCommand
methods.description: Tests the 'Tweaks' menu command opens the correct fragment.

methods.name: testBackupMenuItem
methods.description: Tests the backup preferences menu item opens the correct dialog with all providers listed.

methods.name: testRestorePickerCancel
methods.description: Tests canceling the restore operation when picking a file.

methods.name: testCompleteOperation
methods.description: Tests the complete backup and restore operation flow, including file selection and dialogs.

methods.name: testRestoreMenuItem
methods.description: Tests the restore preferences menu item opens the correct dialog.

methods.name: testShowNotificationPermissionCard
methods.description: Verifies the notification permission card is visible on Tiramisu and above.

methods.name: testDoNotShowNotificationPermissionCardBeforeT
methods.description: Verifies the notification permission card is hidden before Tiramisu.

methods.name: testDoNotShowNotificationPermissionCardIfGranted
methods.description: Verifies the notification permission card is hidden if permission is already granted.
